decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 11/035/02a submitted 23 September 2011 and 11/035/03D submitted 23 November 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The front boundary hedge shown on the approved drawings shall be planted in the first available planting season at or after the implementation of the approved development and shall be permanently retained together.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby approved shall not be commenced until the applicant has put in place arrangements to secure the removal of the immediately adjoining controlled parking zone bay.
description: Construction of a means of access and formation of a vehicle hard standing
